articles.title: “₹80,000 Dispute Turns Violent!” Vegetable Vendor Attacked, Shots Fired in Hapur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hapur: A vegetable vendor was brutally attacked in Gohara village under the Babugarh police station area of Hapur, triggering panic after assailants opened fire in the air. The entire incident was captured on CCTV, and the video is now rapidly circulating on social media.

body.html:
Hapur: A vegetable vendor was brutally attacked in Gohara village under the Babugarh police station area of Hapur, triggering panic after assailants opened fire in the air. The entire incident was captured on CCTV, and the video is now rapidly circulating on social media.

According to reports, the attack is linked to a financial dispute. The victim had allegedly lent around ₹80,000 to a man, and the two had been involved in a long-standing conflict over repayment. On Wednesday night at around 9 PM, when the vendor demanded his money back, an argument broke out.

Soon after, the accused reportedly returned in a car along with seven to eight accomplices. They allegedly abused and assaulted the vendor, vandalised his shop, and fired multiple rounds in the air to create terror in the area.

The sudden violence led to widespread panic, with locals rushing to take shelter inside their homes and nearby shops.

Police reached the spot promptly after receiving information and managed to bring the situation under control. Based on the victim’s complaint, a case has been registered against two named individuals and six to seven unidentified persons.

Station House Officer Munish Chauhan said that multiple teams have been formed to trace and arrest the accused, and assured that all those involved will be apprehended soon.

#Hapur #CrimeNews #ViralVideo #Gunfire #UttarPradesh

articles.title: “Water Instead of Gas?” Shocking Video Shows Cylinder Tampering in Lucknow
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lucknow: A disturbing video has surfaced from the Vikas Nagar area near Gulachin Temple, showing a man allegedly filling a domestic LPG cylinder with water, raising serious safety and fraud concerns.

body.html:
Lucknow: A disturbing video has surfaced from the Vikas Nagar area near Gulachin Temple, showing a man allegedly filling a domestic LPG cylinder with water, raising serious safety and fraud concerns.

According to information, the accused, seen wearing a gas agency uniform, is captured on camera lifting a cylinder and checking its weight before proceeding with the act. He is then seen scooping water from a nearby bucket using a glass and slowly filling the cylinder by pressing a pin with a screwdriver-like object. The entire incident was recorded by a person standing nearby, and the video has since gone viral on social media.

Experts have warned that such tampering with LPG cylinders can be extremely dangerous. It significantly increases the risk of gas leaks and potential explosions, posing a major threat to public safety. They emphasised that such acts could lead to serious accidents.

Officials from the Food and Civil Supplies Department stated that efforts are underway to identify the individual seen in the video. As of now, it remains unclear when the video was recorded and which agency the accused is associated with.

DSO Lucknow, Vijay Pratap Singh, confirmed that the matter is under investigation and assured that appropriate action will be taken once the authenticity of the video is verified.

The incident has triggered outrage among local residents, who have termed it a serious breach of consumer trust and public safety. They have demanded strict action against those responsible and called for a thorough probe by the administration.

#Lucknow #GasCylinder #ViralVideo #PublicSafety #FraudAlert #LPG

articles.title: Controversial Judge Retires Amid Pending Impeachment — Case Set to Lapse
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Shekhar Kumar Yadav of the Allahabad High Court is set to retire on April 15, even as an impeachment motion against him remains pending in the Rajya Sabha for over a year.

body.html:
Shekhar Kumar Yadav of the Allahabad High Court is set to retire on April 15, even as an impeachment motion against him remains pending in the Rajya Sabha for over a year.

Justice Yadav, who took oath as an additional judge on December 12, 2019, and was elevated as a permanent judge on March 26, 2021, will demit office before any action is taken on the motion—effectively rendering it null and void.

🔴 Controversy Triggered by Public Remarks
The controversy stems from a speech delivered on December 8, 2024, at an event organised by the legal cell of the Vishva Hindu Parishad in Prayagraj. During the lecture on the Uniform Civil Code, Justice Yadav made remarks suggesting that the country functions according to the will of the majority and used a derogatory term, triggering widespread criticism.

The Supreme Court of India took note of the speech and sought an explanation from him. However, reports indicate that Justice Yadav did not express regret, maintaining that his remarks were appropriate.

🏛️ Impeachment Motion and Its Fate
An impeachment motion was submitted on December 13, 2024, with signatures from 55 MPs—exceeding the minimum requirement. Despite this, no formal proceedings were initiated.

With his retirement, the pending motion will lapse automatically, as impeachment applies only to sitting judges.

🗣️ Debate on Judicial Conduct
Former Chief Justice of India D Y Chandrachud had earlier emphasised that judges must exercise restraint in public discourse to avoid any perception of bias.

Justice Yadav’s remarks—particularly on cultural values, personal laws such as triple talaq, and advocacy for a Uniform Civil Code—had intensified debates around judicial neutrality and propriety.

Other Past Controversies
● Advocated granting cow protection the status of a fundamental right (2021)
● Suggested national heritage status for figures like Ram and Krishna
● Made observations referencing historical interfaith marriages during court proceedings

📍 Retirement Proceedings
A full court reference will be held at the Allahabad High Court on April 15 to mark his retirement, with judges, bar members, and officials expected to attend.

The development closes a contentious chapter, but also raises broader questions about accountability mechanisms for judges and the limits of public expression from the bench.

body.html:
A shocking hit-and-run incident has been reported from Raipur’s Ashwini Nagar area, where a drunk e-rickshaw driver allegedly rammed into a woman and a scooty rider at high speed before fleeing the scene.

According to police, the incident was captured on CCTV cameras, which clearly show the e-rickshaw crashing into the victims and speeding away immediately after the collision.

Both injured individuals were rushed to a nearby hospital for treatment. However, their current condition has not been officially confirmed.

Police have launched a search operation to trace the accused driver. Officials said that CCTV footage from the area is being closely examined to identify the vehicle and track down the suspect.

Authorities have assured that strict action will be taken once the accused is apprehended.

articles.title: Half-Burnt Body Found in Home: Brother Claims He Tried Cremation Inside Bathroom
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has come to light from Govindpur, Dhanbad, Jharkhand, where a 36-year-old woman’s half-burnt body was recovered from her residence under mysterious circumstances.

body.html:
A shocking incident has come to light from Govindpur, Dhanbad, Jharkhand, where a 36-year-old woman’s half-burnt body was recovered from her residence under mysterious circumstances.

The deceased has been identified as Lipika Kumari, who lived in a house located in the Vastu Vihar residential colony. The property reportedly belonged to her father, a retired scientist from the Central Institute of Mining and Fuel Research (CIMFR), who passed away in 2023.

Lipika was living with her brother, Pranav Rajvardhan (50), while another brother resides about 2 km away.

According to police, Lipika is suspected to have died on the night of April 7. Her brother Pranav allegedly informed neighbours about her death, but they reportedly did not believe him or come forward to help.

Police said that, in a state of panic, Pranav attempted to cremate her body inside the bathroom of the house.

The matter came to light after neighbours noticed a foul smell emanating from the flat and alerted authorities on Monday.

Police reached the spot and recovered the half-burnt body, which has been sent for post-mortem to determine the exact cause of death.

Officials stated that further action will depend on the medical report.

Local residents claimed that both siblings were suffering from mental health issues and had become socially isolated over time, though police have not officially confirmed these details.

Pranav has not been taken into custody so far, and questioning is likely as part of the ongoing investigation.

The incident has raised serious concerns and left the local community shocked.

#Jharkhand #Dhanbad #Govindpur #BreakingNews #MysteryDeath

articles.title: Love Triangle Turns Deadly: Wife Among 5 Arrested in Chilling Murder Plot
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a major breakthrough, police have cracked a sensational murder case in Jajpur district, arresting five persons, including the victim’s wife, in connection with the shooting of a man earlier this month.

body.html:
In a major breakthrough, police have cracked a sensational murder case in Jajpur district, arresting five persons, including the victim’s wife, in connection with the shooting of a man earlier this month.

Superintendent of Police Yashpratap Shrimal confirmed that the accused include the deceased Soumya Sagar Samal’s wife, Subhasree Behera alias Sima; her alleged lovers and cousins, prime accused Tapas Kumar Khilar (26) and Priti Prava Priyadarsini Khilar alias Chinu; along with two firearm suppliers, Suraj Singh (27) and Ankit Thakur (27).

On the night of April 6, Soumya Sagar Samal was returning to his rented house in Kalimegha after closing his chicken shop in Jajpur town when a bike-borne assailant opened fire on him. He was critically injured and initially taken to Jajpur District Headquarters Hospital before being shifted to SCB Medical College and Hospital in Cuttack, where he later succumbed to his injuries.

Police investigation revealed a complex love triangle behind the murder. Subhasree, who worked at a beauty parlour, was allegedly in a long-term relationship with co-accused Priti even before her marriage to Soumya around 18 months ago.

During visits to Priti’s residence, she reportedly developed a relationship with Priti’s cousin Tapas as well. Despite her marriage, she allegedly continued relationships with both.

According to police, tensions escalated when Soumya discovered the alleged affair and strongly opposed it. A confrontation on March 4 between Soumya and Tapas reportedly triggered the murder plot.

Investigators said Tapas procured a country-made pistol and received training from co-accused Suraj and Ankit, with around ₹49,000 allegedly paid by Priti.

Acting on inputs about the victim’s movements provided by Subhasree and Priti, Tapas tracked Soumya and shot him on April 6, leading to his death.

Police formed three teams to probe the case and arrested Tapas along with the weapon suppliers from Rourkela in Sundargarh district. All accused are now in custody, and further investigation is underway.

The case has sent shockwaves across the region, highlighting a disturbing mix of personal relationships and premeditated violence.

#Odisha #Jajpur #MurderCase #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: Hit-and-Run Horror: Pickup Rams E-Rickshaw, 2 Dead — Driver Flees
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident in Gorakhpur claimed two lives and left three others injured after a pickup truck collided with an e-rickshaw on Monday evening. The incident occurred around 5 pm on Kharela Road in the Gida area of Sahajanwa.

body.html:
A tragic road accident in Gorakhpur claimed two lives and left three others injured after a pickup truck collided with an e-rickshaw on Monday evening.

The incident occurred around 5 pm on Kharela Road in the Gida area of Sahajanwa. According to reports, the speeding pickup rammed into the e-rickshaw with force, causing severe injuries to five occupants.

Two victims, identified as Bechan Prajapati (75) and Shivkirat Singh (65), succumbed to their injuries. Their bodies have been sent to a medical college for post-mortem examination.

Three others injured in the accident are currently undergoing treatment at a hospital, where their condition is being closely monitored by doctors.

The pickup driver fled the scene immediately after the collision, turning the case into a hit-and-run. Police reached the spot soon after receiving information and initiated an investigation.

Authorities are scanning nearby CCTV footage to identify and trace the absconding driver. A video of the accident has also surfaced and is circulating on social media.

Further action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

#Gorakhpur #RoadAccident #HitAndRun #BreakingNews #UPPolice

articles.title: Drunk on Duty During CM Visit? UP Cop Suspended After Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a major embarrassment for the police department, a sub-inspector in Muzaffarnagar has been suspended after allegedly skipping duty and being found in an inebriated state during Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s official visit.

body.html:
In a major embarrassment for the police department, a sub-inspector in Muzaffarnagar has been suspended after allegedly skipping duty and being found in an inebriated state during Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s official visit.

According to officials, Sub-Inspector Chaube Singh, posted at Fugana police station, failed to report for duty on Monday when the Chief Minister was in the district for inaugurating an exhibition and attending official programmes.

Circle Officer Yatendra Nagar stated that Singh was later found intoxicated within the premises of the Sadar tehsil office. A video showing him in an allegedly drunken condition surfaced on social media and quickly went viral.

Following the incident, Singh underwent a medical examination, after which he was placed under suspension.

Police officials confirmed that the action was taken for both dereliction of duty and misconduct during a high-profile visit.

The incident has raised questions over discipline within the force, especially during VIP movements where strict protocol is expected to be followed.

#Muzaffarnagar #UPPolice #YogiAdityanath #BreakingNews #PoliceAction

articles.title: Cat Fight Turns Street War! Neighbours Clash Over ‘Kitten Controversy’ in Bengaluru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A bizarre neighbourhood dispute in Seshadripuram escalated into a tense confrontation, forcing police intervention after an argument over pet cats spiralled out of control. The incident began when a resident’s male pet cat allegedly impregnated a neighbour’s female cat.

body.html:
A bizarre neighbourhood dispute in Seshadripuram escalated into a tense confrontation, forcing police intervention after an argument over pet cats spiralled out of control.

The incident began when a resident’s male pet cat allegedly impregnated a neighbour’s female cat. The situation took a turn after the female cat gave birth to four kittens, with its owner blaming the neighbour and confronting them over the issue.

What started as a verbal disagreement quickly escalated into a heated argument, with both sides exchanging abuses.

According to police, tensions peaked when the agitated owner of the female cat allegedly picked up one of the newborn kittens and threw it near the neighbour’s house, further inflaming the situation.

The commotion drew the attention of other residents, as both families continued arguing, refusing to back down. The kittens were reportedly left distressed during the chaos.

Following the escalation, the owner of the male cat alerted the police. A patrol team from Seshadripuram police station reached the spot and brought the situation under control after counselling both parties.

Police confirmed that no formal complaint has been filed so far. However, both sides were warned against escalating trivial issues and advised to maintain peace in the locality.

#Bengaluru #Seshadripuram #ViralNews #NeighbourDispute #StrangeNews

articles.title: ‘Choodiyan Pehno!’ Protest Erupts Inside Police Station — BJP Women Slam Police Over FIR Delay
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: High drama unfolded at Naubasta Police Station after BJP women workers staged a protest inside the premises, accusing police of failing to register an FIR in a woman harassment case.

body.html:
High drama unfolded at Naubasta Police Station after BJP women workers staged a protest inside the premises, accusing police of failing to register an FIR in a woman harassment case.

According to reports, the woman worker's reached the police station and confronted officials, alleging negligence and deliberate delay by the sub-inspector in acting on the complaint. In a symbolic protest, they showed bangles to the Station House Officer, accusing the police of “inaction” and “cowardice.”

The situation escalated as the protesters raised slogans against the police administration, staged a sit-in (dharna), and even recited the Hanuman Chalisa inside the station, creating a tense atmosphere.

The protesters demanded immediate registration of the FIR and strict action against the concerned sub-inspector for alleged negligence in handling the case.

Police Response

Police officials clarified that as per court directions, the matter had been forwarded to the court instead of directly registering an FIR, and further legal process was underway.

However, taking cognisance of the allegations, senior authorities have now directed that an FIR be registered in the case.

Additionally, an inquiry has been initiated at the level of the Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police (ADCP) regarding allegations that the victim was not provided adequate protection. Authorities said further action will be taken based on the findings of the probe.

Deputy Commissioner of Police (South) Deependra Nath Choudhary confirmed that appropriate steps are being taken in the matter.

The incident has sparked debate over police accountability and handling of women harassment complaints.

#Kanpur #Naubasta #BJP #PoliceProtest #WomenSafety #FIR
